select * from ( SELECT rj.JOB_ID jobId , rj.JOB_NAME jobName , rj.LOOP_DATE_DETAIL loopDateDetail, rj.START_DATE startDate, rj.END_DATE endDate, rj.LOOP_DATE_VALUE as loopDateValue, P.START_DATE as execDate FROM rep_job rj LEFT JOIN ( select T.JOB_ID, T.START_DATE, T.Sequence from ( select JOB_ID,START_DATE,row_number() over (partition by JOB_ID order by START_DATE DESC) as Sequence from(select * from REP_INSTALL_LOG where START_DATE is not null) )T where T.Sequence<=1 ) P ON P.JOB_ID=rj.JOB_ID WHERE 1=1
AND rj.JOB_NAME LIKE '%'||#{jobName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
AND rj.JOB_ID IN
#{item}
ORDER BY rj.UPDATE_TIME desc ) where 1=1
SELECT info.rep_id repId, info.report_name reportName FROM rep_info info WHERE 1=1
SELECT info.JOB_ID id, info.JOB_ID text FROM rep_job info

SELECT log.JOB_ID jobId, log.JOB_SEQ jobSeq, log.EXEC_DATE execDate, log.EXEC_STATUS execStatus FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG log WHERE log.JOB_ID=#{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( log.EXEC_DATE =#{execDate, jdbcType=DATE} OR log.LASTEXEC_DATE=#{execDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND log.STATUS = 'E'
